change_summary: The request appears to combine an acceptance-date change with firmware compatibility confirmation. Verified scope, authoritative records, firmware details and the requested date are missing, so classification and specialist routing remain premature.

affected_scope.statement: Acceptance scheduling and firmware compatibility may be affected; the customer, program and target configuration cannot yet be established.

evidence_gaps.statement: Customer, program and change identifiers, verified requester authority, and authoritative linked records are needed to establish permitted scope.
The new firmware revision, baseline revision, target hardware/software configuration and compatibility criteria are missing.
The requested acceptance date, current acceptance milestone and distinction between timing-only and acceptance-requirement changes are missing.

relevant_constraints.statement: Keep the case in read-only intake review; do not move dates or confirm compatibility. Defer specialist requests until scope and authoritative record IDs support concrete domain questions.

program_impact.statement: Schedule and technical impacts remain unassessed; neither a timing-only change nor a change to acceptance requirements can yet be established.

risks.statement: Acting before scope and requester authority are verified could affect the wrong program or create an unsupported schedule commitment.
Compatibility remains unknown. Missing intake evidence does not establish a hardware or firmware failure.

unresolved_questions: Missing intake fields: change_id, customer_id, program_id
Customer ID and program ID, with verified request scope and requester authority.
Change ID and authoritative linked records.
New firmware revision and applicable baseline revision.
Target hardware/software configuration and the intended compatibility criteria.
Requested acceptance date, current acceptance milestone, and whether the request changes only timing or also acceptance requirements.
recommended_next_step: The Program Coordinator should obtain the missing information through human intake review, verify requester authority and customer/program scope, then reclassify the request and route only concrete specialist questions supported by authoritative record IDs.
escalation_reason: The binding policy requires escalation for incomplete or uncertain intake: scope identifiers, requester authority, linked records, firmware/configuration details and acceptance timing or criteria are unresolved.
